text:
Pri (AE): Prospect wants our CAIQ export + a single-page shared-responsibility summary for KMS (rotation/revocation/residency) before POC kickoff. They also asked for two-week POC pricing: Dedicated vs hosted-with-CMK. Who can take?

Dan (Security): I got CAIQ. Need to know: EU-only keys or EU-primary with allowed failover? Also: will they require a live revocation demo during the POC?

Lee (Solutions): From discovery: EU-primary preferred, failover to US allowed only if keys are replicated in their KMS. They want a revocation demo (they will perform the revoke). Traffic ~5 rps, testing 8k token prompts.

setup-bot: CAIQ master template: https://redwood.internal/security/ca iq/ca iq-2026 (internal link)

Dan (Security): Ok. I'll export CAIQ and annotate controls as G/A/R with short rationales. Quick SR summary draft (plain language):
- Redwood: manages model serving, host OS patching, disk encryption for platform artifacts (AES-256), TLS for all network traffic.
- Customer: responsible for data they send, application secrets (API keys), and KMS key material if CMK used (rotation, revocation, residency).
- CMK nuance: Redwood uses customer grants/roles to call KMS; we never persist plaintext key material. If customer revokes grants, decryption fails and calls will return errors until grants are restored.

Lee (Solutions): I'll assemble a 1-page runbook for POC: steps for VPC peering (Dedicated), IAM grant example (hosted), smoke-test curl + expected error on revoke, and which logs to capture.

Ravi (Pricing): Rough two-week numbers (ballpark):
- Dedicated POC: 1x A10G-equivalent reserved pool + private networking + storage + egress + 48-72h setup = USD 16,900.
- Hosted-with-CMK: shared-hosted pool + KMS integration + logs export = USD 2,750.
- Optional: live revocation demo support (engineer on-call during the test window): one-time ops fee USD 1,800.
I'll drop a line-item spreadsheet once confirmed.

Pri (AE): Nice. Dan: please include any CAIQ controls we should flag in contract language (host access, residency). Lee: runbook + IAM JSON + smoke tests. Ravi: itemized quote. ETA 48h (72h if they want live revocation demo scheduled).

Dan (Security): Will export with G/A/R flags and short mitigation notes. I'll call out key-residency as AMBER and host-access on hosted as AMBER. ETA EOD today.

Lee (Solutions): Runbook draft by 3pm: steps, IAM snippet, smoke tests, and a revocation verification checklist. Example IAM snippet I'll paste in doc.

Ravi (Pricing): I'll upload the detailed quote spreadsheet and post link here by 4pm PT.

Pri (AE): Thanks team ":thumbsup:" — I'll tell the prospect 48h and note the extra lead time for revocation demo.
